dataset: Celeb-FBI: full-body images with age, gender, height and weight labels
license: Community Data License Agreement - Permissive 1.0 (as declared by Kaggle dataset metadata)
identityField: filename serial number; verified unique after filtering
split: deterministic gender + weight-bin stratification; 4,958 train / 619 validation / 619 test; identity-disjoint
limits: Celebrity height and weight are public metadata, not measurements taken when each photo was captured.
The paper reports the validated weight range as 41-110 kg; raw Kaggle files include sparse values above 110 kg that are treated as weak labels.
Only 12 accepted images are >=140 kg, so no production claim is allowed for that range.
Images contain background, clothing, pose and public-figure biases.
